Blood Glucose & Continuous Monitoring
Traditional meters
: Available on medical supply sites like
Allegro Medical
for basic fingerstick testing.
CGMs
: Patch-based sensors (like Abbott FreeStyle Libre or Tracky) track interstitial fluid glucose levels 24/7 without routine finger pricks.
Data sync
: Most modern CGMs push real-time trends and high/low alerts directly to a smartphone app.
PharmEasy
Smartwatches & Wearable ECG
Heart monitoring
: Advanced smartwatches feature integrated electrical sensors to capture on-demand ECG readings.
General metrics
: Devices track heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen (SpO₂), and skin temperature.
Medical grade vs wellness
: Consumer wristwear can spot potential irregularities like atrial fibrillation, but they do not replace standard clinical 12-lead ECG machines.
Indiana University Health
Sleep Trackers & Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM)
Sleep tracking
: Dedicated rings, bands, and smartwatches analyze sleep stages, resting heart rate, and nocturnal movement.
Remote care
: RPM ecosystems use cellular or Bluetooth gateways to securely transmit vital signs (glucose, blood pressure, ECG) to clinical care teams.
